_readme: EU register substitutes for the SEC layers (PRO-72 Phase 2), read 2026-09-04 from the public search pages: UK Companies House (find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk, query 'creandum'), the Swedish company register as republished by allabolag.se (Bolagsverket data: org numbers, addresses, 2025 revenue in kSEK, employees, CEO), and the Finansinspektionen company register (fi.se/en/our-registers/company-register, query 'creandum': the authorised AIFM, the Swedish AIF funds, the foreign AIF/AIFM registered for marketing). Filing-grade for the entity set, HQ and the manager's authorisation; none of them lists portfolio holdings.
